notes.text: The manuscript date is read Oct. 4 83. Its surrounding frame has three sides and is open above. A pale mark after 83 was initially considered by reader C, then excluded after root independently judged it a mottle lighter than the numeral strokes.
The front-side industrial listing is part of the source and is transcribed in full. The literal EXEC token remains CSS 3ATCH|CSSBATCH; no command-name normalization has been applied.

The page writes conditions on sigma, supp and RR, then a stability inequality 2g(s)+nu_s≥3. Three additional inequalities are written separately at the upper right. The first two g subscripts remain p|s uncertain; the transcription does not assert equivalence among the three inequalities.
The note calls 4,5 inverses of one another, under the condition that cutting is only along marked circles. This is a source claim; reader C did not verify it.

The paragraph says the relative twist is defined in terms of 4) and 5), with tau_r=id when r belongs to blackboard Z. The subscripts are read as r from their short shoulder strokes. Reader C did not prove the stated identity.

The final sentence calls the twist associated with a marked cutting circle a new structure, with the last word tentatively importante. The clear word marqué before the parenthesis was omitted by both witnesses.

The lower arrow annotation is not resolved as a semantic exists sign: its strokes may involve a j-descender and an underline. The tentative sign remains marked in place, and no exclamation is supplied.

Relatif is an interlinear addition below the canceled word after Le. The dark stroke over its left portion remains uncertain between underline and deletion, so both local states are retained inside the insertion.
The current 2 and 5 are retraced. No separate earlier numeral can be read securely beneath them, so no invented canceled digit has been added.
Reader and root independently saw paired dark dots after the earlier pas) and before the live T_g,nu S_alpha. Both colons are retained at medium confidence.
The repeated crossed doubled glyph remains t|blackboard L. Its prefixes s and d are lowercase. The four connectors are plain shafts, not arrows; nearby paper holes are excluded.

The small upper phrase favors avec omega^L over avec inv, but its disconnected curls and raised stroke remain open. Plus-minus stands separately to the right, rather than as a superscript attached to the prose.
The lower-left 40 is retained as a margin number in another unnamed hand. It is not assigned to the author’s own pagination.

All visible front-side wording, signs and drawing strokes were read from the whole page, two native halves and 29 saved crops. The logical line count 78 includes text lines, displayed formula rows, diagram rows, the date, printed identifier and folio. No OCR, research or TeX compilation was used, and reader C performed no mathematical computation or proof on this page.

Conditional algebra check by root: if the uncertain first two genus subscripts are s and g_s>=0, then 2g_s-2+nu_s>=1 is equivalent to 2g_s+nu_s>=3 by adding2. That condition implies 3g_s-3+nu_s>=0, since the latter left side equals (2g_s+nu_s-3)+g_s. The converse fails at g_s=1,nu_s=0. The page merely lists the inequalities, so no assertion that the author claimed equivalence is made. The check does not settle the doubtful subscripts.

checks.outcome: Conditional on common subscript s and nonnegative genus: adding2 gives equivalence of the second and third inequalities; adding g_s proves their implication to the first. g_s=1,nu_s=0 satisfies the first but not the other two. This is a targeted algebra check, not a proof of the twist or cutting assertions, and changes no ink reading.
